name: Kasuga Yuusuke
source: The protagonist who is a first-year student. Unable to forget his childhood friend [url=/c14021]Shiori[/url] who was also like an older sister to him, he moves back into his hometown in order study in the school she teaches at. He lives alone because his parents live too far away from the school. Yuusuke is a very kind person who can't ignore a person in need of help. He initially wanted to join the soccer club, but upon being forced to join the student council, he gave up on his pursuit.
